function stuDownload(){
  if(!STU.code){toast("Nothing to download yet");return}
  var n=(STU.lastPrompt||"aurisi-app").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g,"").slice(0,30);
  if(!n)n="aurisi-app";
  var a=document.createElement("a");
  if(STU.doc){
    if(/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(STU.code)){
      var blob0=new Blob([STU.code],{type:"text/html"});
      a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob0);a.download=n+".html";
      document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
      setTimeout(function(){try{URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);a.remove()}catch(e){}},800);
      toast("This document has Hindi/unicode text — downloaded as HTML (opens anywhere, print to PDF)");return
    }
    var pdf=stuPdf(STU.doc);
    var blobp=new Blob([pdf],{type:"application/pdf"});
    a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blobp);a.download=n+".pdf";
  }else if(STU.files.length>1){
    a.href=URL.createObjectURL(stuZip(STU.files));a.download=n+".zip";
  }else{
    var blob=new Blob([STU.code],{type:"text/html"});
    a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=n+".html";
  }
  document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
  setTimeout(function(){try{URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);a.remove()}catch(e){}},800);
  toast(STU.doc?"Document downloaded — ready to print or share":(STU.files.length>1?"Project ZIP downloaded — unzip and open index.html":"App downloaded — open it in any browser, works offline"));
}
